items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: And Martha Raye came and her mother used to come with her. Her mother's name was Peggy.

ctx.x: And Martha Raye came and her mother used to come with her. Her mother's name was Peggy. And she used to come out there with her a lot of times. And Martha and I were talking about this in Honolulu about a couple of months
ago. She came over to do a show, a benefit show I think. It wasn't -- it was a variety show over there. And she came to do it for the kids over there in a variety club.
